checkpoint: Resident indexed MLA composition and original selection-order diagnostics

canonical_reference.scope: Original operators applied to separately declared chronological selected-set diagnostic. Does NOT replace or canonicalize original raw reference results.

native_policy: Existing chronological top512, lower-index ties; no selection arithmetic/order change this stage. QR/query/cache/selection/status linked exact views; independent latent-token and pooled-indexer page tables.

original_prefill_variance.scope: Original score inputs and original operators only. Canonical ordering is explicitly separate diagnostic; original raw captures unchanged. No model generation claim.

original_default_decode_variance.scope: Original default persistent decode top-k and original MLA/value/O only; same untied membership in all runs. Explicit chronological diagnostic is separate, not an accepted parity tolerance.

prefill.scope: Warmed entire indexed MLA operation: prepare/cache, indexer/paged score/selection, attention and value/O. One caller stream fence; extra unattributed CUPTI context synchronization retained. No full-model performance claim.

decode.scope: Warmed entire indexed MLA operation: prepare/cache, indexer/paged score/selection, attention and value/O. One caller stream fence; extra unattributed CUPTI context synchronization retained. No full-model performance claim.

comparison_profile: Actual raw GGUF indexer and identity-materialized MLA tensors; matched original cuBLAS130101 for projections. General CUDA suite uses system CUDA13.5. Original decode selector auto resolves persistent on SM120; prefill uses original per-row operator.
remaining: Full-model logits/tokens and original variance must qualify order/tie consequences; observed similarity is NOT an accepted error tolerance. mHC/MoE complete MLA blocks and model admission/generation, full backend/placement/performance/serving goal remain incomplete.
